title: Returned-Payment Fee Amount on the Respite and Short-Term Stay Account
content:
Each payment returned unpaid on a stay under the Respite and Short-Term Stay Agreement is followed on the stay statement by one returned-payment fee, an add-on line that references the returned-payment entry.

## The amount

The returned-payment fee is the service charge on the returned payment, rounded half up to the cent once, on the final total. The service charge on the returned payment is the returned payment fee of the stay type, as listed among the stay type's account settlement figures.

## Worked statement (hypothetical stay)

| Line | Figure |
|---|---|
| Payment returned unpaid | 2,390.00 |
| Returned payment fee of the stay type (settlement figures) | 35.00 |
| Returned-payment fee posted, referencing the returned-payment entry | 35.00 |

## Points of reading

| Question | Answer |
|---|---|
| How many fees does one returned payment carry? | One |
| Which entry does the fee reference? | The returned-payment entry it arises from |
| Where is the fee posted? | As an add-on on the stay the returned payment belongs to |
